skillset.skill: 15s CT - 6000% Earth DMG (PHY). For 10s, reduce enemies' DMG RES by 30%.
skillset.arts:
18000% Earth DMG (PHY). For 15s, increase allies' Arts by 4/s. If used when not on last wave, increase allies' Arts by 8/s instead.
Note: This unit's Arts Gen is Type E and will not stack with other Type E Arts Gen.
skillset.truearts: 120000% Earth DMG (PHY). 100% chance to inflict Bleed. If used when enemy is Bleeding, 100% chance to increase Bleed Level by 1 (MAX: 3).
skillset.superarts: 250000% Earth DMG (PHY). For 25s, reduce enemies' PHY RES by [100 + 100 x Bleed Level]% (MAX: 400%).

passive.ability1:
When own HP is 80% or above, increase own Arts by 3/s. Additionally when unaffected by Status ailment(s), increase own Arts by 2/s. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
Note: This unit's Arts Gen is Type EX1 and will stack with all other Arts Gen effects apart from the same unit.
passive.ability2: Increase own DMG by 20% against enemies under 30% HP.
passive.ability3: Increase own DMG by [2% x own ATK / 100].
passive.ability4: Unit EXP UP 20% UP. (When Riyo's SP. Art is owned)
passive.ability5: At the Start of Quest, increase own Arts gauge by 10. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name. (When Riyo's SP. Art is owned)

trueweapon.name: The Ripper
trueweapon.skill: 50s CT - 8000% Earth DMG (PHY). For 20s, increase own Earth DMG by 70%.

passive.ability1: When equipped by Riyo, increase own ATK by 50%, and Freeze RES and Paralysis RES by 100%. Does not stack with Abilities of the same name.
